stories.h: Wind and heavy rain arrive tonight; outages possible
stories.s: Scattered showers give way to a stronger system after dark. Interior gusts of 30-40 mph peak around midnight, below advisory level but enough for power outages. Up to an inch of rain; showers linger Sunday.

stories.h: Eastbound Narrows Bridge narrows to two lanes tonight
stories.s: From 8 p.m. Saturday to 6 a.m. Sunday, the two left lanes approaching the eastbound SR 16 bridge close. Ramps and the toll plaza stay open, unlike Friday night's closures.

stories.h: Democrat Strickling edges ahead in razor-thin 25th District race
stories.s: Jenn Marie Strickling overtook GOP Rep. Cyndy Jacobsen by 82 votes Thursday in the Puyallup-area House seat; a recount looks likely. About 280 challenged ballots can still be cured; more counting comes Tuesday.

coming.h: Lakewood council takes up 2027-28 budget, tax levy
coming.s: The 6 p.m. meeting covers the biennial budget, the 2027 property tax levy and fee schedule, plus a police commissioning ceremony.

coming.h: Tacoma council set to adopt 2027-28 budget
coming.s: Council members plan a final vote on a budget closing a $40 million gap, after amending it to keep five community service officers.
